name: Flare Dominion
geological_features: Supervolcanic caldera complexes exceeding 800 kilometers in diameter
Planet-spanning lava tube networks large enough to swallow capital ships
Tectonic compression ridges where continental plates buckle into molten mountain ranges
Magma oceans occupying entire hemispheric basins
specific_features: The Coronae — a ring of seventeen simultaneously active supervolcanoes along the equator
Pyroclastic storms that reach the upper atmosphere and rain molten glass for weeks
Magnetic field distortions caused by iron-saturated magma currents
resources: Rare actinide concentrations in magma upwelling zones
Crystallized carbon formations under extreme pressure
Geothermal energy potential rated at planetary scale
description: Flare Dominion is a world in perpetual self-immolation. Its surface is a hellscape of magma seas, buckling tectonic plates, and supervolcanic eruptions that can be observed from neighboring systems during peak activity. The planet's large mass and dense iron core drive convection cycles of extraordinary violence, pushing molten rock to the surface in continent-drowning floods that reshape the geography on timescales of months rather than millennia.

The atmosphere is a choking shroud of sulfur dioxide, vaporized silicates, and volcanic ash, lit from below by the orange-white glow of exposed magma. Pyroclastic storms rage across the surface with enough force to strip starship-grade hull plating. The electromagnetic environment is equally hostile — iron-laden magma rivers generate shifting magnetic anomalies that scramble navigation systems and communications without warning.

Geological surveys suggest Flare Dominion is a young world still undergoing planetary differentiation, its internal structure not yet settled into stable layers. The seventeen equatorial supervolcanoes known as the Coronae appear to be connected by a single magma reservoir of staggering volume, and models predict a full simultaneous eruption event within the next several thousand years that could temporarily increase the planet's albedo enough to be visible as a brightening point to nearby systems.

Despite its lethality, Flare Dominion draws mining interests like a flame draws insects. The volcanic processes concentrate rare actinides and refractory metals in surface-accessible deposits of extraordinary purity. Several corporations maintain shielded orbital platforms for remote extraction, but the profit margins war constantly with equipment losses. The planet has claimed more mining drones and automated rigs than any other catalogued world in the sector.
